name: SVD-LLM V2 Attention: Truncation-Aware SVD for LLM Compression.
description: SVD-LLM V2 Attention: Truncation-Aware SVD for LLM Compression. Direct low-rank factorized parameterization maintaining explicit U, Sigma, and V^H factor buffers, with trainable LoRA adapters for recovery fine-tuning.  Hardened for production use across diverse transformer architectures: - DistilBERT (Flat MHA) - RoBERTa / BERT (Nested Encoder Self-Attention) - GPT-2 (Causal Decoder with Conv1D) -

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
